Description
Overview
The HMV-G Series micro Vickers hardness testers provide standardized Vickers hardness measurement for laboratory and production quality control. The lineup includes G31 models with a built-in CCD camera for automatic length measurement, G21 models, fully automated FA variants with electrically driven revolver and XYZ stages, and manual units with optical heads. Optional color-camera models and electric micrometer-equipped XY stages are available.
Features
Automatic length measurement (G31 series): integrated CCD camera and software implement standardized automatic reading of Vickers indentations.
Operator-focused software (G31 series): intuitive main operation sequence designed for repeatable workflows across operators.
Automated operation (FA/XY series): electrically driven revolver and XYZ stages enable unattended series testing; electric micrometer on XY stage allows precise automatic positioning and full-sample/edge recognition (G31-FA).
Downloads / Documents (titles)
Shimadzu Analytical and Measuring Instruments (brochure)
HMV-G Series - Micro Vickers Hardness Tester (brochure)
Application notes: Multifaceted Evaluation of EV Drive Motor Shaft Produced by Radial Forging; Evaluation of EV Drive Motor Shaft by Radial Forging Process - Confirmation of Correlation between Hardness Distribution and Element Distribution; Measuring the Vickers Hardness on the Shanks of Hardened Screws in Accordance with ISO 18203 (JIS G 0559)
Manuals: HMV-G31-FA/G-FA, HMV-G31-XY/G-XY Instruction Manual; HMV-G31/G21 Instruction Manual; Instruction Manual - Software Installation
Applications
Quality control and R&D hardness measurement of forged and machined components, including EV drive motor shafts produced by radial forging.
Correlation studies between hardness distribution and element/compositional mapping in metallurgical evaluation.
Conformance testing such as measuring Vickers hardness on screw shanks per ISO 18203 / JIS G 0559.
Technical specifications
Product type: Micro Vickers Hardness Tester (HMV-G Series), models include G31, G21, FA and XY variants.
Optical system: built-in CCD camera for automatic length measurement (G31); optional color camera; manual optical head available.
Measurement capabilities: standardized automatic length measurement and automatic reading for Vickers hardness evaluation.
Automation options: fully automated FA machines with electrically driven revolver and electrically driven XYZ; electric micrometer-equipped XY stage; automatic full-sample image and edge recognition (G31-FA).
Software: dedicated PC software with guided main sequence; software installation manual provided.
Documentation: brochures, application notes and instruction manuals available for download.
